items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I'd had a band for a short while with Flip Phillips and Ralph Burns, Dick Taylor Johnny Blowers, Clyde Lombardi

ctx.x: So, Benny was set on these guys, so Woody wanted Shorty and he also wanted Gazzo. And I'd had a band for a short while with Flip Phillips and Ralph Burns, Dick Taylor Johnny Blowers, Clyde Lombardi, we were going for Coca-Cola to England to entertain the troops, but it never got off the ground. For about six months, we were around New York and we made some V discs with them, too --
